description:
Global stablecoin metrics -- total supply, per-chain breakdown and the top stablecoins by market cap. Use it when the user asks about stablecoin supply, USDC or USDT dominance, or overall market liquidity.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_stablecoin_metrics
